text: make_example() writes standard template pkgdown/menus/examples/ default. template includes YAML front matter build_assets() reads constructing menu: Two fields drive menu: title: used menu label. missing, filename used converted title-cased title (e.g. example_hello_world.Rmd → "Example Hello World"). HTML title stripped, titles authored QMD slides still render cleanly navbar. index: numeric ordering key. Lower indices appear first; ties fall back alphabetical title order. Missing non-numeric values treated Inf, sending entry end. strType controls filename prefix (Example_ vs Cookbook_). end menu unless split across separate subdirectories pkgdown/menus/.

title: Adding Examples and Other Assets to a pkgdown Site
text: build_assets() orchestrator. ’s : Walks every subdirectory source_dir (default pkgdown/menus/). subdirectory, renders .Rmd files via render_rmd() .qmd files via quarto::quarto_render(), writing HTML pkgdown/assets/<menu>/. Reads front-matter metadata source files determine menu labels order. Updates _pkgdown.yml place: adds menu component (title built subdirectory name, examples becomes "Examples" your_other_menu becomes “Menu”), inserts navbar$structure$left, writes sorted menu: list text / href entries. Removes menu entirely pkgdown/assets subdirectory empty existing YAML menu entries point existing assets. Existing menu items whose target HTML still exists disk preserved across rebuilds, can hand-edit _pkgdown.yml add curated links (e.g. externally hosted content) without losing next run. Render failures surfaced cli::cli_warn() messages class gsm.utils-render_failure. offending file skipped rest menu built normally.

title: Utilities for gsm package developers
text: Updates existing GSM package latest standardized templates: Refreshes .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/ current issue templates (Bug, Feature, Technical Task, Documentation Task) Updates .github/workflows/ latest GitHub Actions workflow definitions Use function keep package’s CI/CD infrastructure synchronized latest conventions. ### check_workflow_compliance() Checks package’s GitHub Actions workflows comply gsm.utils templates: Verifies required workflow files present Checks version headers match current gsm.utils version Compares critical workflow content templates Provides detailed reporting compliance issues Can used CI/CD enforce workflow standards ## GitHub Actions Workflows inst/gha_templates/workflows directory contains standardized GitHub Actions workflow templates Gilead packages: pkgdown-cleanup.yaml: Automatically removes pkgdown PR preview directories gh-pages branch pull requests closed keep repository clean. pkgdown--assets.yaml: Builds deploys pkgdown documentation sites automatic menu addition asset creation via gsm.utils::build_assets(). Creates PR preview sites /pr/{number} (, depending pkgdown configuration, /pr/{number}/dev), deploys production //dev sites push main dev. R-CMD-check-dev.yaml: Lightweight R package check PRs dev branch, running Ubuntu current minimum supported R versions faster CI feedback development. R-CMD-check.yaml: Runs comprehensive R package checks PRs main across multiple platforms (macOS, Windows, Ubuntu) R versions ensure package integrity release. r_releaser-caller.yaml: Reusable workflow building attaching R package source tarballs GitHub releases, using A2-ai/r-releaser action configurable options data compression vignette building. test-coverage.yaml: Computes test coverage using covr logs result every run. pull requests, coverage posted sticky comment updates push. coverage-summary.json (written via gsm.utils::emit_coverage_summary()) attached release asset triggered release: published event. workflow-template-check.yaml: Ensures workflow compliance checking package’s .github/workflows directory matches gsm.utils templates. Runs pushes main release branches verifies file presence, version headers, critical content maintain standardized CI/CD across GSM packages.
